connector.name: Ticket Discovery
connector.registryDescription: Search and compare concert ticket prices across platforms
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package ticket-discovery-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wmarceau account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
